name: verksted-agent-clis
//: Not a package and not installed from here. The Dockerfile reads these pins and installs them globally into the image. They live in a manifest rather than on the RUN line so dependabot can see them: a new agent CLI now arrives as a pull request that CI has run, instead of appearing in whatever the next rebuild happened to resolve. Dependabot's npm updater treats a manifest with no lockfile as exact pins to bump, which is what these are.
